canonical_identity.title: Muṇḍā and Dravidian Languages
canonical_identity.publisher: Office of the Superintendent of Government Printing

scope: Munda and Dravidian languages; bibliographic authority identifies Mundari material including Ranchi/Palaman/Jashpur/Bamra varieties. DSAL exposes Volume 4 in its LSI BookReader.

verified_manifestations.provider: Digital South Asia Library, University of Chicago

verified_manifestations.relationship: derived scan of map facing p. 7

canonicalization.rule: Treat DSAL, catalogue/Google/OpenLibrary records, scans and reprints as manifestations of the 1906 LSI Volume IV work unless edition-level collation demonstrates substantive independence.

rights_access.work: historical government publication; individual manifestation rights must still be recorded
rights_access.map: Wikimedia Commons marks the 1906 LSI Munda-language distribution map Public Domain Mark 1.0; source states it faces page 7
rights_access.text_ingestion: Do not promote text merely from discoverability. Obtain lawful stable bytes, hash them, establish printed-page/PDF-page concordance, then extract only supported passages.
rights_access.consent_cultural: Historical publication does not establish present-day community consent or cultural permission; culturally sensitive claims require separate review.

promotion.reason: No passage-level immutable permitted text bytes and concordance established in this run. Map is rights-clear at manifestation level but its historical cartographic assertions are not automatically promoted as current cultural/geographic truth.

audit_principle: Never infer current cultural facts from a colonial-era survey without explicit provenance, temporal qualification and corroboration.
